findings.summary: The trailing-blank trim is wrapped in `try { ... } catch (err) { /* blanks are skipped on read */ }`. The error is swallowed with no log, so a failing deleteRows is invisible in the GAS execution log.
findings.suggestion: Keep it best-effort (the post must still succeed), but record the failure: `catch (err) { Logger.log('roastingUpsert_: trailing-blank trim failed — ' + err); }`. This matches the Logger.log pattern in connectors/gas/shopcoffee.gs:302-312.

findings.summary: oldKeys is built from the raw sheet value row[1]. Profiles starting with = + - @ are stored with the text guard prefix (sheetSafeCell_), so on re-post the key no longer matches the fresh key and those rows are counted as rowsAdded instead of rowsUpdated. The data is still correct because the whole week is replaced; only the counters in the response are wrong.
findings.suggestion: Key the read-back value through sheetUnguardCell_ (connectors/gas/Code.gs, the helper just above the key-normalizer comment), as the Code.gs comment requires for any key built from a sheet read. Add a sequential test: post `=HYPERLINK("x")`, then re-post it, and assert rowsUpdated === 1.

findings.summary: An empty roasting payload (rows: []) passes validation and returns result:'ok'. doPost then stamps the LAST_INGEST_cropster heartbeat (Code.gs, stalenessStampHeartbeat_ call after dispatch) without writing anything. Once the source is armed in step 5, a broken scrape that returns zero rows would look healthy. The roster kind refuses empty payloads for this reason (roster_empty).
findings.suggestion: Refuse rows.length === 0 in roastingPayloadRefusal_ with a specific message such as 'roasting_empty: a roasting post needs at least one row'. The step brief is silent on this, so decide it explicitly and note the choice.

findings.summary: The grid-growth fix (commit bc2b036, insertRowsAfter before setValues) and its test were committed after the GREEN commit (d3ae011), so that test was not written RED-first. The mock support it needs (gridMaxRows) was already in the RED commit 25a7ab4. The behaviour is correct, but the TDD record shows the fix without a RED run.
findings.suggestion: No code change needed. Record in the step log that the grid-growth case was added post-GREEN as a review fix and was not confirmed RED first.
